, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the landmark on the August 2021 Vogue cover as the White House instead of the Washington Monument (visible in the background behind trees). This led to looking up and calculating the White House’s height, resulting in an incorrect answer instead of the correct 185 yards for the Washington Monument.
